wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/obj/copy_diag_name.py: """`copy()`'s warnings named the helpers it delegates to.

    copy("missing.txt", "out.txt");
    php:    Warning: copy(missing.txt): Failed to open stream: No such file or directory
    elephc: Warning: file_get_contents(missing.txt): ...

`__rt_copy` is `__rt_file_get_contents` followed by `__rt_file_put_contents`, and those two name
themselves. php names the function the USER called in every one of these lines.

The name travels through a pair of globals rather than a new parameter on helpers that already
have four: the delegating caller publishes what php should print, the readers prefer
